properties.carrier_stats: SELECT carrier_code, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(dep_delay) AS avg_delay FROM flights GROUP BY carrier_code
properties.pruned: SELECT carrier_code, origin, dest, dep_delay FROM flights WHERE flight_month = '2026-03'
properties.delayed: SELECT flight_id, carrier_code, dep_delay FROM flights WHERE dep_delay > 45 AND carrier_code = 'AA'

properties.filtered: SELECT code, description, origin, dest FROM airlines WHERE code = 'AA'
properties.by_dest: SELECT dest, COUNT(*) AS n FROM airlines GROUP BY dest
